Education & experience

BA-SKI-D

Sunday 21 – Sunday 28 February 2027Val d’Isère, French Alps

A week in the Alps where lectures, skiing and shared evenings build relationships that last well beyond the slopes. The headline partner is seen on the mountain, in the social feed and at the dinner table.

Opportunity£7,000

Headline package

The visible identity across the whole BA-SKI-D week.

  • Company logo on the branded BA-SKI-D tops or jerseys
  • Social media exposure featuring the branded tops
  • Branded beach balls, plus a separate social post featuring them
Included in headlineIncluded

Evening activations

Proposed as part of the headline package, subject to programme fit.

  • Sponsored CPD speaker for one evening, with CPD where applicable
  • Sponsored dinner with the option of an after-dinner speech
  • Branded cocktail evening
Joint & multi-eventTwo non-competing brands can share the week, with the evenings allocated between them. See packages →
Evening allocation and delivery are confirmed in the partnership schedule.
